tei:div.tei:p: 321) ༄༅/ bsangs bsur bsngo ba'i cho ga rgyas pa phrin las myur 'grub 'dod 'byung yid bzhin sprin phung bzhugs so/ 322) na mo/ skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rnams// bdag sogs gus pas skyabs su mchi// bdag gis mchod sbyin bgyis pa'i dge /'gro la phan pa mchog 'grub shog ༈ o raṃ/ bdag gi phung khams skye mched 'dis// 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs su gsal// thugs ka'i hrīḥlas ram̐ 'phros pas// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa yi// me thab ye shes me dpung 'bar// dud sprin 'ja' 'od 'khrug pa yis// nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi khengs// dud pa'i gseb nas sprul pa 323) yi// mchod pa'i lha mo dpag med 'phros// gzugs sgra dri ro raig bya chos// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs// sprin ltar gtibs pas mchog dman mgron/ thams cad dgyes pa skongs byed gyur/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang rgyal tshogs// dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong dang*// yul lha gzhi bdag lha srin kun// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus bcas// thams cad mchod sbyin mgron du gshegs// rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul mnyes byas bshags// 324) dge la yi rang chos bskor bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol 'debs shing*// dge 'bras byang chub rgyur bsngo'o// na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tad khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin 'phrul// 'dod yon longs spyod mchod pa'i sprin// gang la gang 'dod tshim byed pa'i// bsangs dang bsur gyi mchod pa 'di// dgongs brda' snyan brgyud bka' gter dang*// bshad sgrub gsang sngags gsar rnying gi /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams kyi// sangs rgyas sras dang sprul pa'i 'khor// byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal sogs// skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnams la 'bul// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes nas kyang*// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// brtse chen thugs rjes skyobs pa dang*// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol//

325) ༈ thag pa phyi nang mdo rgyud lung*// gsang sngags smin grol chos kun gyi// dkyil 'khor bsam yas grangs med pa'i// lha tshogs yi dam zhi dang khro// yab yum 'khor dang yang 'khor bcas// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// bsangs dang bsur mchod 'di 'bul gyi// zag med mchod pas mnyes gyur nas// bdag sogs mos pa'i bu rnams kyi// las nyon sgrib tshogs kun byang zhing*// nyams chags 'gal 'khrul gsor chud do// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// myur du stsol bar mdzad du gsol// dag pa mkha' spyod sprul pa'i zhing*// phrin las bsgrub pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// ye shes las las grub pa'i tshogs// dpa' mo dpa' mo'i rigs rnams dang*// bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu stobs can/ chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud rigs// 326) bka' dang dam las gnas pa yi// srung ma dam can rgya mtshor bcas// bsangs dang bsur mchod 'di bzhes la// chos byed skyong zhing dam nyams sgrol// phrin las thogs med sgrub mdzad gsol// ༈ stong gsum 'jig rten mnga' dbang bsgyur// tshangs pa brgya byin phyogs skyong bcu// rgyal chen bzhi sogs gtsang ris kyi// dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*// de dag 'khor du gtogs pa yi// phyi nang gsang ba'i lha ma srin// steng gi nyi zla gza' skar nas// 'og gi sa bdag lto phye'i bar// snang zhing srid pa'i lha klu kun// bsangs dang bsur mchod 'dis bzhes la// 'jig rten khams kun bde ba dang*// char chu dus 'babs lo phyug legs// nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi bar mdzod/ ༈ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag rigs// yul bdag gnas bdag gter bdag dang*// gtsug lag dben gnas yul dgon gyi// dkor bsrung 327) nor bdag gnyan gu'i rigs// g.ya' sgang nags rigs skyed mo'i tshal// mtsho rdzing chu mig sh-ing dang brag /so so'i rten gnas ji snyed na// chags shing gnas pa'i gzhi bdag dang*// 'go ba'i lha dang skyob pa'i mgon// kun la bsangs dang bsur mchod 'bul// bdag sogs gzhi byed gar gnas kyang*// nyes las skyob dang legs tshogs spel// ci bsam grub pa'i gdong grogs mdzod// gang dag nag po'i phyogs kyi rigs// sa steng sa 'og sa bla ru// rgyu zhing gzhan la gnod byed pa'i// bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*// gdon rigs gsum brgya drug cu sogs// nad yams rims kyi bdag po dang*// srog gcod dbugs len mdangs 'phrog pa'i// gnod byed ma rungs gdug rtsub kun// kun kyang bsangs dang bsur mchod 'dis// dga' zhing mgu dang tshim gyis la// skye 'gro kun dang

328) khyad par du// bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas la// gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor zhi bar mdzod// ༈ gzhan yang khams gsum 'jig rten gyi// 'gro b.rigs drug lam rgyud lnga*// skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i// sems can ma lus mtha' dag dang*// khyad par bar do'i sems can rigs// dri bsur 'tshol zhing kun tu 'khyams// 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang sdug bsngal gyi// rtag tu gdung zhing nyam thag pa'i// skyabs med snying rje'i yul gyur pa// kun la bsur mchod 'di bsngos pas/

/ci 'dod longs spyod thob nas kyang*// ris drug so so'i sdug bsngal dang*// bar do'i 'jigs skrag kun zhi nas// 'gro kun thar lam 'khod gyur cig ༈ de ltar bdag gi lhag bsam gyis// bsangs bsur 'dod yon phun tshogs pa'i// mchod pa dam pa 'di phul bas// mchog dman mgron rigs kun mnyes shing*// ye shes pa rnams thugs dam bskongs// mchog thun dngos grub stsal 329) du gsol// 'jig rten pa rnams dgyes shing tshim// 'gal rkyen bar chad bsal du gsol// bsgo ba'i lha rnams mnyes nas kyang*// phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod// gnod pa'i bgegs rnams tshim nas kyang*// lan chags bu lon 'khor gyur cig /'gro la 'dod dgu'i char phabs te// thams cad byang chub thob par shog /chos nyid bden pa'i mthu stobs dang*// sngags dang ting 'dzin byin rlabs dang*/ lhag bsam rnam dag bden pa yis// ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'byung gyur cig /'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i mthus// bstan pa dar zhing sems can bde// bdag sogs gnas skabs mthar thug kun// bde legs phun tshogs 'byung ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du// bkra shis char chen rgyun mi chad// rgya cher babs pa'i byin rlabs ni// nam mkha' 330) mnyam pa 'byung bar shog mgron rnams so so rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ bsur mchod kyi rim pa rgyas par bkod pa 'di ni/ klo yul bhung bhal zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs kyi dpon po pad+ma'i ming can gang gis bskul ngor bris pa dge'o/ bkra shis/
